description: This file defines the Image_Graph_Font class, a component for rendering fonts in the PEAR PHP OO Graph Rendering Utility. It includes properties and methods for setting font attributes such as name, size, color, and angle, and extends a common base class.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Font
classes.description: A class representing font properties for graph rendering, including methods to set font attributes and retrieve font configuration options.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Font
methods.description: Constructor for the Image_Graph_Font class, initializes font name and size.

methods.name: setColor
methods.description: Sets the color of the font.

methods.name: setAngle
methods.description: Sets the angle of the font for rendering.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the font.

methods.name: _getFont
methods.description: Returns an array of font options for rendering, including name, color, size, and angle.
